comment: The languages the converter writes (ADR 0016): each one's Remastered locale directory and its name in its own language. exceptions list a language's rows allowed to differ from the base in their % specifiers: locale, table (a strings.kpd section), row id, why. rows lists a language's shorter text for a table row whose own does not fit where it shows (stage L3): locale, table, row id (1-based), text (an inner NUL written \u0007, as Remastered's XML has it), why. layout lists a dialog record's rectangle a language's text needs (localization's stage L3, tests/c/test_locale.c's the_languages_texts_fit): locale, dialog, record (0 is the dialog), rect [left, top, right, bottom] inclusive and/or, for a glue button (type 14), text: the rectangle its text is laid out in (extra[4], DrawFlcButtonText 0x4c8650; a text button's is its own rect, an FLC button's a box beside its movie), why. speech lists a language's missions whose triggers may differ from the base's in more than TIME (converter speech): locale, mission, why.

exceptions.why: "% Complete" and its translation have a bare percent sign, no conversion: no format string reads the row

rows.why: "Неиспользуемое строение зергов 5" is 184 pixels in font10, past the status panel's name even widened (174); the other unused buildings' names fit

speech.why: Remastered's ruRU map adds its own fix: a Set Switch action in trigger 20 (before its comment, which moves to the next action) and a Switch condition in trigger 24; the speech keeps the base's triggers and takes the TIME of every action the two have alike

layout.why: the status panel's unit name: Russian names reach 173 pixels in font10 ("Неиспользуемое строение зергов"), the control had 152; it takes the panel's empty sides, past the wireframe (30..93) to the dialog's edge (269)
the supply lines' labels ("Затрачено припасов: 200", 107 pixels) and the next three: the control had 111 pixels; their right side is empty while supply shows
the third supply line, as the others
the morph label "Создание пристройки" is 110 pixels, the control had 108
"Общий счет" in font16x is 131 pixels, 1 past the right-aligned label's 491..621; its left moves 4 pixels into the empty space before it

"Одиночная игра" in the main menu's font is 174 pixels, the text box beside the movie 150: it takes a second line, which the box lacked, below the first (the button's rect 0..319 x 0..189 holds both; wider, the text would leave the button's rect, which its glow redraws)
"Вступительный ролик" is 234 pixels, the left-aligned text button 170; it reaches right over the empty background
"Загрузить повтор" is 195 pixels, the centred text button 194
"Создать матч" is 152 pixels, the centred text button 146
